verdict.rationale: Postman's docs describe cloud workspaces, sync, and collaboration features but never document a local-only mode without a cloud account; multiple hands-on reports confirm the opposite — Postman requires login, syncs secrets to its servers, and needs internet connectivity at startup for telemetry, with users losing data or being locked out when offline (postman-comm-1, postman-comm-6, postman-comm-12, postman-comm-14, postman-comm-15). No vendor documentation claims a genuine offline/local-workspace mode, so this is a straightforward 'none' rather than a disputed claim.
